data: How long is the MBA program at USIU-Africa?

The MBA program at USIU-Africa typically takes 2 years (4 semesters) to complete for full-time students. However, the actual duration may vary depending on your course load and whether you're studying part-time or full-time.

The program requires completion of:
- 18 courses (54 credit hours)
- Including core courses, specialization courses, and electives
- A capstone project or comprehensive exam

USIU-Africa offers flexible scheduling options with evening and weekend classes to accommodate working professionals, which may extend the completion time for those who choose to take fewer courses per semester.

For accelerated completion, summer sessions are available, potentially allowing students to finish the program more quickly.
